data.body:
COPIED-VOTE CONFUSION ON ps3, RESOLVED WITHOUT INTERVENING — worth recording because the obvious
reaction would have been wrong.
2505/2507/2510 showed Verified-1 on their current patchset, but inspection showed those votes were
COPIED, not earned: Gerrit's copy condition is 'changekind:NO_CODE_CHANGE OR TRIVIAL_REBASE', and
those three changes' own diffs did not change in the ps3 push — only their PARENTS did (2503 and
2506 carried the marker fix). Gerrit therefore classified them as trivial rebases and carried the
OLD failing ps2 verdict forward onto a patchset that had never been tested.
Per-change evidence gathered before acting:
  2503 ps3  0 runs started, 0 verdicts        (untested yet)
  2504 ps3  1 run, 1 verdict                  (genuinely re-running)
  2505 ps3  0 runs, copy notice               (stale copied -1)
  2506 ps3  1 run started, 0 verdicts         (running)
  2507 ps3  0 runs, copy notice               (stale copied -1)
  2510 ps2  0 runs, copy notice               (stale copied -1)
DECIDED NOT TO RECHECK. 2504's ps3 shows the CI bot posting '-Verified' to CLEAR the copied vote and
then STARTING a fresh run, so the system already re-runs copied-vote changes on its own. Posting
rechecks would have added redundant runs to a Gerrit host that is already returning 504s under load —
and 'the vote looks red so retry' is precisely the reflex AGENTS.md warns against. Waiting instead.
